title: Validate spectral NDMI discriminator on detected Pakistan traces (build gate)
description: Gate before building the terrain-adaptive discriminator (l2c, option A). The probe (AUC 0.94) used a PROXY label (channel pixels vs hand contacts); validate the ACTUAL use case: per-trace mean-NDMI on DETECTED Pakistan traces. (1) compute per-trace NDMI for all detected traces; pick a moisture threshold; (2) conditioned-FN: of hand-traced CONTACTS, how many would NDMI flag as creek (eating real contacts)? (3) render audit panels - high-NDMI (flagged-creek) vs low-NDMI (kept-contact) traces over hillshade+S2 for the geologist; (4) compare vs the flow-filter on Pakistan (over-flags 33%) - is NDMI a cleaner discriminator? Verdict + recommended NDMI threshold + caveats in docs. Reuse scripts/spectral_drainage_probe.py + drainage_verify panels. Lane: scripts/ + docs only, NO core. If it holds -> build terrain-adaptive selection (flow-accum steep/vegetated, NDMI low-relief/arid).

title: Detection front-end: pick operator + band weighting
description: Pending the Phase 1 experiment (recall + linearity). Choose the response operator (gradient vs structure-tensor anisotropy/coherence; Canny is the front-runner - NMS gives thin edges, hysteresis beats top-k) and the band set/weights (corrected ranking: curvature/slope dominate; iron_oxide best spectral). Resolves Q2 with c3r.

title: Build unified normalised training GeoPackage from seed data
description: Consolidate the three seed regions (data/raw: Canada 653, Nepal 411 UTM44N w/ sparse Class, Pakistan 853) into one GeoPackage with a normalised schema (region, class, source, geometry); reproject to a common analysis CRS or per-region UTM; convert the richer Canada v2 INTERLIS superset (1160 lines) and decide if it supersedes the 653-line set. See data/DATA_MANIFEST.md. Parent: Phase 0.

title: Phase 6 - Packaging & release
description: Epic. QGIS plugin-repo submission, docs, first-time-user tutorial. Verify dependency-free v1 installs cleanly on Windows/macOS/Linux (OSGeo4W). GPL licence; state shipped-model provenance if ML included. Can release classical-first without waiting on Phase 5. See ARCHITECTURE.md S11, S16.

title: Calibrate conditioning gate + map-view sinuosity filter for auto traces
description: DISCOVERED in end-to-end Nepal auto-detection (scripts/detect_attitudes_nepal.py, docs/PHASE1_REPORT.md S5). The conditioning gate 1e-3 (fine for curated hand-drawn traces) is too lenient for AUTO-detected traces: straight map-view segments draped on relief form 2D vertical 'planes' (dip~90) that pass a 3D conditioning test - 29% of reliable fits were dip>=85 at gate 1e-3. They cluster at cond~2.5e-3 vs ~4.6e-2 for real fits; raising to 1e-2 drops near-vertical share 29%->5% (3324 clean attitudes, median dip 19.8). TODO: principled gate calibration AND/OR a map-view straightness/sinuosity filter (strike/dip signal lives in trace sinuosity; a straight segment cannot constrain dip). Feeds the conditioning-ranked review queue (S9.1). Related to wiu.

title: M6 - Persistence + export + project-state
description: GeoPackage (primary): traces+classifications+attitudes; CSV attitudes table; export structural-analysis results. Versioned project-state so human classifications survive a re-detect with new params (ARCHITECTURE Q8 - default to preserve/merge). Documented schema.

title: Drainage pre-filter (D8 flow-accumulation) for trace detection
description: BUILT on branch feat/drainage-filter (NOT merged): planesight/core/detect/drainage.py (flow_directions/accumulation/azimuth/channel_network/channel_proximity/is_drainage), 9 tests; scripts/drainage_test.py (sweep + 4-panel figs). Nepal: flags traces overlapping channel net AND running along flow. Geomorphic pre-filter per S9.1. CRITICAL REVIEW found the headline oversold - see child verification + hardening issues before merge/integrate.

title: Recommend default multi-band input stack + Sentinel-2 composite
description: Combine P1a/P1b findings into a recommended default input stack and a geology-oriented S2 false-color composite (e.g. SWIR 12-11-2). Resolves Q1. Parent: Phase 1.

title: Adaptive per-AOI input weighting (deferred)
description: DEFERRED until we have more + structurally diverse labeled regions and a validated detector. Nepal-vs-Pakistan proved no single band recipe is optimal everywhere (curvature wins in mountains, SWIR in arid; the Shield would be spectral-dominated/DEM-useless). GOAL: weight/select the input stack per scene. KEY CONSTRAINT (chicken-and-egg): 'most effective combo' is defined against ground truth, which we lack on new AOIs - so the mechanism CANNOT be per-scene 'measure effectiveness vs truth'. Real options: (1) unsupervised proxy = lineament richness + cross-band edge agreement (beware roads/rivers/field edges are also linear; must validate vs labels); (2) supervised recipe = learn scene-descriptors(relief stats, spectral diversity, veg fraction)->weights across many labeled regions (v2/ML, gated on 9vt); (3) presets (mountainous/arid/low-relief) + human-in-the-loop review gate (robust near-term). Infra already supports it: structure_tensor() and the stack take per-channel weights. Do NOT build on 3 narrow regions (overfits). Extends D8 (configurable stack). See planesight-bc1 result.

title: Revisit drainage exclusion: measure residual drainage in KEPT set + convexity-as-weight
description: Geologist still sees major creek/drainage flagging in test data. Re-open the curvature-sign 'dead end': we only ruled out the NARROW case (local curvature SIGN as a binary pixel filter, 47% vs 47%) - NOT convexity as a per-trace AGGREGATE signal combined with the flow network. Tasks: (1) MEASURE how much drainage survives into the KEPT (not-flagged) set = the recall gap behind the gut feeling; (2) test a per-trace convex/cross-cutting aggregate signal + ridge-following (complement of drainage via flow divides) as added discriminators; (3) report whether flow-only is leaving creeks in. Grounds the skeptic's drainage check.

title: M0 - In-QGIS pipeline checkpoint (no UI)
description: Extend scripts/qgis_console_checkpoint.py to run the FULL headless pipeline (fetch->derivatives->detect->drainage-flag->link->strike/dip) inside the QGIS Python console on a small AOI, returning in-memory trace + attitude layers. Flushes out integration risk: GDAL-in-QGIS, per-AOI UTM choice, micromamba-vs-QGIS-Python env. Nothing downstream is trusted until this passes. Foundation for all milestones.

title: Calibrate GLO-30 correlation_length via empirical error variogram
description: From 85g (verified HOLDS): the correlated-tilt uncertainty floor ~ sigma_z/L_c, and L_c=500m is an order-of-magnitude literature estimate, not measured. The FLOOR EXISTS (real fix; long traces no longer report sub-0.1deg), but the ABSOLUTE value (~0.65deg) is uncertain ~1 order of magnitude. Measure a GLO-30 vertical-error variogram (e.g. vs a higher-accuracy reference DEM or ICESat-2) to calibrate L_c. GATES: any hard ABSOLUTE dip/dd-uncertainty threshold must wait for this. Also consider modelling horizontal misregistration (a second correlated source, documented-not-modelled in 85g).

title: Drainage filter: verify (audit panel + conditioned-FN + sensitivity)
description: From critical review. (1) Render ~30 RANDOM flagged (orange) traces over hillshade+S2 for geologist audit: creek or contact? (verifies removed set is really drainage - never checked). (2) Report false-negative CONDITIONED on valley-overlapping hand traces (~18% on 22, not the diluted 1.3%/408) with small-N caveat. (3) Publish parameter-sensitivity range (angle_tol 20-45, min_aligned 0.4-0.6 -> removed 23-47%, hand-flagged 0-24), not a single 31%. DECISIVE before trusting the filter.

title: Data-driven attitude rules from hand-traced datasets
description: Don't guess thresholds - derive them. From the hand-traced Nepal/Pakistan/Canada datasets: (1) measure LOCAL strike/dip variability over sliding windows -> set the 'outlier/implausible local change' bar empirically (not a guessed +/-10-20deg); (2) characterize hand-trace morphology distribution (rule of V's: V / straight=near-vertical / contour-parallel=near-horizontal) as plausibility priors. Feeds the skeptic's smoothness + morphology checks.

title: Implement refined drainage rule: overlap-flag + confidence rank (mono+length)
description: From planesight-4l8: replace the brittle flow-ALIGNMENT flag in flag_drainage with an OVERLAP-based flag (sinuosity-robust, flags traces heavily embedded in the channel network - matches geologist 'exclude all of these'). Demote elevation-monotonicity + trace length to a CONFIDENCE RANK on the review queue (long + low-monotonicity/cross-cutting = rescue candidate at top). Convexity confirmed OUT. Thresholds (overlap cut, min length) from 5ug; run AFTER zod continuity so fragments are linked before size-filtering.

title: Dependency-free derivative engine (TPI, slope, hillshade, curvature)
description: Compute the configurable multi-band stack from DEM + Sentinel-2 using numpy/scipy/GDAL ONLY (no opencv/scikit-image, D11): TPI, slope, multi-azimuth hillshade, plan/profile curvature, + S2 false-color composite. Parent: Phase 0. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.2, S11.

title: Phase 1 report: recommendations + bootstrap verdict
description: Synthesise P1a-P1d into a short report: recommended input stack, chosen v1 detector, and the bootstrap go/no-go verdict. Updates Decisions Log (Q1, Q2, Q10) in ARCHITECTURE.md. Parent: Phase 1.

title: Uncertainty budget: add correlated-error (random-tilt) term
description: The Monte-Carlo uncertainty in fit_plane assumes INDEPENDENT per-point DEM noise, so for well-sampled high-relief traces it underestimates (Nepal median ~0.3 deg). Real GLO-30 error is spatially correlated. Add a correlated component - e.g. a per-sample random planar tilt with std ~ sigma_z / correlation_length - so the budget reflects real DEM behaviour and doesn't average down by sqrt(N). Also consider horizontal misregistration as an error source. Discovered during S6.4 implementation.

title: M3 - Structural analysis: stereonet + mean + fold axis (functionality 4)
description: Equal-area (Schmidt) stereonet of selected attitudes; Fisher mean pole + alpha95 cone (uncertainty-weighted using per-attitude error); best-fit girdle -> fold axis (beta) via orientation-tensor eigen-analysis (numpy.linalg.eigh, reuses plane_fit SVD machinery); rose diagram. Bidirectional map<->stereonet selection linkage. Stereonet MATH lives in core/ (dep-free, unit-tested); rendering decision (matplotlib vs custom QPainter) deferred to build time. Defer axial-trace construction + domain clustering.

title: Phase 2 - Classical detection MVP
description: Epic. Implement Phase 1's chosen classical detector + vectorisation (threshold -> skeletonise -> trace -> Douglas-Peucker), DEPENDENCY-FREE (numpy/scipy/GDAL). Deliverable: AOI -> auto-drawn candidate trace polylines layer. Detector lives behind a swappable interface (S5.3). See ARCHITECTURE.md S8.1.

title: Probe per-trace elevation-monotonicity (and NDWI water-mask) for low-relief arid creek discrimination
description: Discovered from planesight-0bf: per-trace NDMI fails the real use case on Pakistan (AUC 0.64 vs probe's 0.94 pixel proxy; high-NDMI end is coastal water shorelines, not creeks). Both low-relief arid discriminators tried so far fail: flow-accum has no knee (DRAINAGE_SWEEP.md), NDMI is near-chance per-trace (SPECTRAL_VALIDATE.md). Next: (1) test per-trace elevation MONOTONICITY (the sinuosity-robust 4l8 signal that worked on Nepal) on detected Pakistan traces - does a creek's monotonic thalweg descent vs a contact-V crossing separate them? (2) If any moisture index is revisited, MASK S2 water with NDWI first (the 0bf high-NDMI artifact). Reuse scripts/spectral_validate.py harness + drainage panels.

title: Training-data bootstrap GO/NO-GO gate
description: CRITICAL GATE. Test map-draping to auto-generate labels and decide go/no-go for the v2 ML path. Probe failure modes: concealed/inferred contacts (no surface signal), thin-feature registration offset (2-3 px label error on 1-2 px features), generalisation smoothing away the Vs, heterogeneous licensing/datums. Review what map2loop learned about map-linework reliability. Output: a clear verdict + fallback plan (seed + active learning). Resolves Q10. Parent: Phase 1. See ARCHITECTURE.md S8.3.

title: Validate drainage filter + 61f rule on Pakistan/Canada (transfer off Nepal)
description: The whole drainage rule (overlap-flag, accum=15, rank, j8t hardening) is Nepal-ONLY validated. Run the existing harnesses (scripts/drainage_verify.py, drainage_residual.py, drainage_test.py - they already have REGIONS for pakistan/canada) on both regions. Report per-region: channel-network density (% of map) at accum=15 - is it sensible on flatter/low-relief terrain or does DRAIN_ACCUM need per-region recalibration (the 8->15 calibration was Nepal-only)?; overlap-flag % flagged/kept; the rescue-rank queue behaviour. Render the audit panels for the geologist (are flagged traces creeks in Pakistan/Canada too?). Deliver docs/DRAINAGE_SWEEP.md: does the knee transfer, per-region recommended accum, and the honest caveats. Lane: scripts/ + the doc only (the core algorithm is settled - do NOT touch core/detect/drainage.py).

title: Example-driven detection PROBE (gates M5)
description: Research gate before any example-driven UI. Test (classically, no ML) whether a signature extracted from a FEW example traces (local derivative profile + spectral response + orientation + morphology) generalizes across an AOI to find similar boundaries. Score with the positive-unlabeled machinery (core/detect/score.py, recall-at-budget). Honest risk: lighting/season/lithology variation may break generalization. Deliver a verdict doc + AUC/recall before committing UI. Same validate-before-build discipline as the drainage/spectral probes.

title: Review most-diagnostic DEM derivatives for bedding/contacts
description: Literature + experimental review (run on the Canada tile) of which DEM derivatives best expose bedding/contacts: TPI, curvature, openness, sky-view factor, etc. Feeds the default input stack. Resolves part of Q1. Parent: Phase 1.

title: Sentinel-2 cloud masking + temporal compositing + scene-ID provenance
description: SCL/QA cloud masking + seasonal-median temporal compositing + scene selection (single scenes are often cloudy). Pin resolved scene IDs + acquisition dates into output provenance for reproducibility. Resolves Q7. Parent: Phase 0. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.3.

title: Review modern edge/line detection implementable in numpy/scipy
description: Evaluate classical (Canny, ridge/valley, phase congruency via FFT, Hough) and note DL options (U-Net/SegFormer/Aghaee CNN) for v2. CONSTRAINT: v1 candidates must be implementable with numpy/scipy/GDAL only (D11). Pick the v1 detector. Resolves Q2. Parent: Phase 1.

title: AOI -> STAC fetch: GLO-30 DEM + Sentinel-2 L2A (AWS Earth Search, anonymous)
description: Resolve AOI (draw/import/extent) -> STAC query against AWS Earth Search/Element84 (genuinely anonymous, D13) -> fetch/stream Copernicus GLO-30 DEM + Sentinel-2 L2A COGs, mosaic + clip to AOI. MPC only behind a signing shim if used. Evaluate plain requests vs pystac-client to stay dependency-free. Parent: Phase 0. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.1.

title: Phase 1 - Research spike
description: Epic. Lit + experimental review to choose the input stack and v1 detector, and to run the training-data bootstrap GO/NO-GO gate. Run experiments on the existing Canada tile. Deliverable: a short report with a recommended input stack, a chosen classical detector, and a bootstrap verdict. Resolves Q1, Q2; gates Q10. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.2, S8.3.

title: Confirm bootstrap verdict: real published-map probe + S2-edge re-run
description: Recommended (non-blocking) confirmation of the 9vt verdict (docs/BOOTSTRAP_VERDICT.md): (1) probe one real published source (Macrostrat / provincial map) over an AOI to ground the published-map registration offset estimate; (2) re-run scripts/bootstrap_probe.py with Sentinel-2 edges included to quantify the resolution benefit (10-20m vs 30m). Both refine the 'snapped+filtered auxiliary labels' path; v1 classical ships regardless.

title: Adversarial verifier: skeptic subagent + /verify command
description: Fresh-context (unanchored) methodology+geology skeptic. .claude/agents/skeptic.md + .claude/commands/verify.md. Tools Read/Bash/Grep - RE-RUNS to verify, doesn't just opine. Stance: refute-hard but judge accuracy-not-perfection (incomplete ground truth is EXPECTED). Trigger: on-demand /verify + proactive nudge before any major empirical claim enters docs/memory. METHODOLOGY checklist: denominator/selection-bias, coverage/nodata artifact, parameter fragility, positive-unlabeled discipline, circular validation, synthetic-vs-real, small-N, network-flake-as-result, 'did we verify the removed set'. GEOLOGY checklist (from geologist): fragmentation=low-confidence (prefer long continuous traces), rule-of-V's morphology plausibility, topography-following suspect EXCEPT horizontal bedding, anthropogenic (roads/ridge-crests), local strike/dip smoothness. Build AFTER the grounding studies so it carries DATA-DERIVED thresholds.

title: Per-AOI metric CRS policy (custom TM/Lambert or tiling)
description: Derive a per-AOI projected CRS (transverse Mercator/Lambert centred on AOI) or tile the AOI; handle UTM zone straddle and polar AOIs (>84N/>80S) where UTM is undefined. Metric CRS is required by the plane-fit engine. Resolves Q6. Parent: Phase 0. See ARCHITECTURE.md S7.3.

title: Horizontal-bedding identification (Grand Canyon calibration)
description: Topography-following is suspect EXCEPT genuine horizontal/near-horizontal bedding (contour-parallel, repeats consistently across many elevations; rare, low-deformation/erosional or fold-top only). Use a flat-lying AOI (Grand Canyon) to derive a flag distinguishing horizontal bedding from drainage so the topography-follows-suspect rule has a principled override. Related to the data-driven rules + drainage revisit.

title: Drainage algorithm hardening: pit-fill + block-mean downsample
description: From critical review. drainage.py uses D8 with NO depression/pit-filling (best=0 init -> flats/pits are sinks, channels fragment) and STRIDE subsampling dem[::3,::3] (aliases/shifts narrow channels). Tolerable on steep Nepal, WILL DEGRADE on low-relief Pakistan/Canada. Fix: block-mean downsample + priority-flood pit fill. Do BEFORE generalizing the sweep to other regions.

title: Detection back-end: response->polylines (thin/trace/simplify)
description: DONE. detect/vectorize.py: Zhang-Suen thin + skeleton trace + gentle Douglas-Peucker + pixels_to_world + extract_polylines. Pure numpy/scipy (no skimage, D11). 11 tests. Gentle simplify preserves valley V's for the plane fit (S6.3).

title: Per-region drainage accum (density-target rule) - Pakistan needs ~8x Nepal
description: planesight-amn found the Nepal-calibrated DRAIN_ACCUM=15 transfers to Canada (14.8% channel) but NOT to Pakistan (33% channel at 15; needs ~115-120). High-end sweep shows Pakistan has NO knee (density +3..4.5pts/step across 4..240 vs Nepal +0.7..1.3) - flow-accum is a blunt discriminator on low-relief arid terrain. Recommended fix: replace the fixed accum with a density-targeting rule (pick accum so channel net ~= 15% of valid map) in core/detect/drainage.py, OR a different channel definition for low-relief AOIs. See docs/DRAINAGE_SWEEP.md.

title: Phase 3 - Strike/dip engine
description: Epic (CORE SCIENCE). Sample DEM along reviewed traces -> PCA/SVD best-fit plane -> strike/dip. Acceptance criteria: (1) TWO degeneracy metrics - conditioning lambda2/lambda1 (primary guard) + planarity lambda3/lambda2 (D12); (2) propagated dip/strike uncertainty + computed GLO-30 error budget (S6.4); (3) SYNTHETIC-DEM recovery gate passes BEFORE any real data, incl. dip-direction downslope sign check (D14, S6.6); (4) windowed vs single-centroid output decided (Q5). Reuse qgSurf/GeoTrace math. See ARCHITECTURE.md S6, S10.

title: Acquire low-relief / Canadian Shield labeled AOI (deferred)
description: DEFERRED per strategy: prove the method in DEFENSIBLE high-signal terrains (mountains/arid) first, then earn into hard cases. Our 3 current regions are 2 mountainous (Nepal, Canada=Alberta/BC Cordillera at 116-117W/52-53N) + 1 arid (Pakistan) - ZERO low-relief/spectral-dominated examples. The Canadian Shield case (glaciated, flat, contacts as 2nd-order vegetation/soil/spectral signal, DEM useless) is UNREPRESENTED, so we cannot test or validate adaptive weighting for it yet. UNLOCK: obtain a low-relief shield AOI (e.g. Ontario/Quebec) with published contact linework (Macrostrat / provincial geology maps). This single dataset enables the spectral-dominated regime and is higher-leverage than speculative weighting code. Gates planesight adaptive-weighting work.

title: Phase 5 - Supervised ML detector
description: Epic (gated on the Phase 1 bootstrap verdict, Q10). Assemble training set (bootstrapped maps if go + seed + active learning), train from-scratch semantic-seg model (U-Net/light transformer) -> skeletonise -> vectorise, export to ONNX, ship as OPTIONAL 'smart detect' upgrade via onnxruntime fetched on first use (D3, D11). State model data provenance/licence before shipping (S16). See ARCHITECTURE.md S8.

title: Phase 4 - Human-in-the-loop UX + triage
description: Epic. The review gate AND the triage system that makes it scale (S9.1): editing tools, bedding/contact/fault/drainage/reject classification panel, confidence-ranked review queue, batch accept/reject, DEM-computable drainage auto-reject (flow accumulation), tunable parameter panel, guided vs one-click modes. Also the versioned project-state schema + re-detect-vs-preserve-edits policy (Q8). See ARCHITECTURE.md S9, S10.

title: M2 - Strike/dip on supplied traces (functionality 3)
description: Decoupled strike/dip engine in the GUI: load ANY trace layer (incl. user hand-drawn Nepal/Canada/Pakistan), sample DEM along traces, fit_plane -> styled attitude point layer (qgSurf-style markers, reuse scripts/qgis_style_attitudes.py / debug/nepal_attitudes.qml), reliability-colored, dip labels, conditioning/planarity/uncertainty attrs. No dependency on detection. Per-AOI UTM CRS (gj9).

title: M4 - Detection + review/triage gate (functionality 2)
description: Run detector (ClassicalTraceDetector) -> drainage-flag -> link_polylines -> confidence-ranked review/triage panel (S9.1): queue by rank/conditioning/planarity/drainage-flag, click-to-zoom/flash, one-key classify (bedding/contact/fault/drainage/reject), batch accept/reject; only accepted traces feed the strike/dip engine (re-fit on accepted subset). Native QGIS editing for add/delete/snap/split/merge. Generic detector = the cold start for example-driven (M5).

title: Tune link_polylines params: under-links on real data
description: 61f real-data validation: link_polylines at default max_gap_px=5/max_angle_deg=20 merged only 60 of 3740 kept Nepal traces (~1.6%) - under-linking. Likely: 5px (150m) gap too tight for real contact breaks, and/or linking the already Douglas-Peucker-SIMPLIFIED polylines gives poor end-tangents on 2-vertex fragments. Options: raise max_gap_px, or link on pre-simplification polylines, or relax tangent. Validate with a before/after fragment-count + the geologist's eye that it doesn't over-merge. (zod's deferred real-data validation, now observed.)

title: GUI v1 - PlaneSight QGIS plugin (dockwidget)
description: Build the QGIS GUI on the validated headless core. Dockwidget shell, guided-only, thin-slice-first. Functionality map: (1) Aggregate -> (3) Measure -> (4) Analyze -> (2) Detect -> example-driven. PyQGIS/Qt confined to planesight/gui + planesight/plugin.py; core stays dependency-free. All heavy work in PlaneSightTask (planesight/tasks/base.py). See docs/HANDOFF.md NEXT PHASE + ARCHITECTURE.md S5/S9/S10/S11.

title: Survey open-source structural datasets (strike/dip + lidar/aerial-derived) for training & validation
description: Survey and catalogue openly-licensed datasets to bolster training and (especially) validation: (a) structural measurement databases with strike/dip points (StraboSpot, USGS NGMDB/GeMS OrientationPoints, state surveys, Macrostrat, Geoscience Australia, BGS, GSC); (b) lidar/photogrammetry-derived structural orientation datasets and virtual-outcrop sets; (c) datasets pairing mapped contact/bedding traces with DEMs. For each: name, contents, format/access, coverage, LICENSE, and usability as training labels vs ground-truth validation vs both. Feeds the Phase 1 report and the validation strategy (Q4); related to the bootstrap gate. See ARCHITECTURE.md S6, Q4. Parent: Phase 1.

title: Scaffold QGIS plugin skeleton + repo + CI + dev env
description: Plugin Builder skeleton, git repo (SSH), CI, dev environment, QgsTask background-worker harness (S5.3). Parent: Phase 0.

title: M1 - Data aggregator slice (functionality 1)
description: The thin vertical slice. PlaneSightDockWidget replacing the placeholder QDialog (planesight/gui/main_dialog.py). AOI via map-extent + draw-rectangle. Run button wraps fetch+derivatives in PlaneSightTask (off UI thread, progress+cancel). On finish: add pre-styled DEM/S2/derivative layers (hillshade/slope/curvature/TPI + false-color). Independently shippable, zero detection risk. Show AOI estimate (tiles/size/UTM) before run.

title: ClassicalTraceDetector: wire front-end + back-end behind ABC
description: Concrete TraceDetector (register_detector) combining the chosen response front-end with extract_polylines; detect(stack, transform)->List[Trace] in CRS coords. Then it is swappable with a future ONNX detector.

title: Detection eval: recall + linearity + attitude sanity
description: Score detected polylines vs drawn traces (recall) + label-free linearity, AND run them through fit_plane for well-conditioned/sane attitudes (capstone + mound-reject backstop, closes Phase 2 into Phase 3).

title: Integrate drainage filter into ClassicalTraceDetector as review-flag
description: Route drainage-flagged traces to the review queue (S9.1 confidence-ranked), NOT delete (strike-valley contacts ~18% FN are recoverable). Apply BEFORE any continuity bridging. Gated on the verification issue.

title: M5 - Example-driven detection (trace-a-few-find-the-rest)
description: Centerpiece UX, contingent on the PROBE. User traces a few example boundaries -> propagate to find/trace all similar ones -> review -> refine (the active-learning loop, ARCHITECTURE S8.3). Unifies M4 detect+review into one loop. Classical signature-match first; ONNX model is the v2 upgrade of the same loop.

title: Phase 0 - Foundations & data backbone
description: Epic. QGIS plugin skeleton + the data backbone. Deliverable: draw an AOI in QGIS and get a clean, reprojected multi-band raster stack (DEM derivatives + cloud-free Sentinel-2 composite). Dependency-free (numpy/scipy/GDAL only, D11). See ARCHITECTURE.md S5, S7, S11. Sub-tasks track the detail.

title: Detection continuity fix (edge linking after drainage removal)
description: Geologist obs: detected traces more fragmented than hand interpretation. Causes (reviewer): hysteresis breaks at sub-threshold dips; trace_skeleton splits at junctions; no gap-bridging. Fix: lower hysteresis low + binary_closing for 1-2px gaps, and endpoint linking by orientation continuity in vectorize.py. APPLY AFTER drainage removal (else reconnects drainage). Risk: bridging real gaps / merging parallel layers.
